name: IOCCC 98 Flight Sim
author: Jeremy Zeiber
description: A port of the famous IOCCC 98 flight simulator: fly with the arrows, X throttles up and Z down, X+Down opens the map, X+Z returns to the menu.

descriptions.en: A port of the famous IOCCC 98 flight simulator: fly with the arrows, X throttles up and Z down, X+Down opens the map, X+Z returns to the menu.
descriptions.it: Porting del celebre simulatore di volo dell'IOCCC 98: pilota con le frecce, X aumenta e Z riduce la manetta, X+giù apre la mappa, X+Z torna al menu.
